sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Abhishek Singh,Akshaivar Singh
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.
None has appeared on behalf of the informant.

2. The present second bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 116 of 2019,
under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Titron, District Saharanpur with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

The first bail application of applicant was rejected by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 04.02.2021.
3.
It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
Applicant is husband of deceased.

Though the marriage of deceased with applicant has taken place about two months prior to the incident but the allegations of dowry Shoeb vs State Of U.P. on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149700111/
1 demand and harassment of deceased, levelled against the applicant, are wholly false.

entities.text: dowry Shoeb vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was further submitted that the first bail application of applicant was rejected vide order dated 04.02.2021 and that only two witnesses have been examined so far, whereas, applicant is in judicial custody since 22.11.2019, having no previous criminal history, and thus, he has already undergone the detention of more than 4 years.
Lastly, it was submitted that in case, applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and argued that applicant is husband of deceased.
The incident took place only about two months after the marriage.
In postmortem report, 13 ante-mortem injuries have been shown on the body of deceased and the cause of death is ante-mortem throttling, which shows that deceased was brutally murdered.
5. After considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, gravity of the offence and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, no case for grant of bail is made out.
6. Accordingly, the instant second bail application filed on behalf of applicant Shoeb is rejected.

7. However, keeping in view the period of detention of the applicant, the trial Court is directed to expedite the trial and to decide the same expeditiously, preferably within a period of one year from the date of production/receipt of copy of the order.
8. A copy of this order be forwarded to the concerned trial court for necessary compliance.
